grammar.0.note: This is a short, simplified history; reality is far more complex. Official or history-based sites (such as the Deutsche Rentenversicherung, bpb.de, DOMiD) are good sources. Check names and years.
grammar.1.note: In written history the Präteritum is used, in speech usually the Perfekt. sein, haben and modal verbs are almost always in the Präteritum.
grammar.2.note: „Gastarbeiter“ is a historical term; today people often say „Arbeitsmigranten“ or „Menschen mit Einwanderungsgeschichte“. Respect what the person themselves wants to be called.
quiz.1.why: der Familiennachzug = bringing family members over.
